title: Retrieve every VCF Automation deployment page in stable order
prompt:
Implement the VCF Automation 9.0 deployment collection client in this repository using only the Go standard library. VCF Automation is the VCF 9.0 successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation. Complete `(*Client).ListDeployments` in `vcfautomation/client.go` so it retrieves every page of `GET /deployment/api/deployments` according to the protected `docs/contract.json`. The contract is derived from Broadcom's authoritative xAPIs reference documentation because VCF Automation has no published specification in the Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository.

Each request must use bearer authentication, accept JSON, set the zero-based `page`, use the client's configured `size`, and request deterministic `id,ASC` sorting. Encode populated `projects` and `status` options as comma-separated values and encode a populated `search` option as a string; omit each optional query field entirely when it is unset. Return errors for non-2xx responses or malformed response JSON. Return all deployments in stable ascending ID order, even when deployment IDs within and across returned pages are not ordered. Add table-driven test cases for the implementation.

Acceptance: `go test -race ./...`. The protected loopback contract mock serves only the operation named by the contract and exposes a race-safe request log. The verifier checks the request method and path, query values and omission, authorization, headers, and body. Semantically equivalent ordering and percent-encoding of query parameters are accepted. It never contacts a live VMware endpoint. `go.mod`, everything under `docs/`, and everything under `internal/`, including the mock and verifier, are protected; do not modify those files.
